TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF USE - PetHelp Last update: March 2026 1. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS By registering and using PetHelp, you accept these Terms and Conditions in accordance with current Colombian law, including Law 1581 of 2012 (Personal Data Protection), Decree 1377 of 2013, and Law 1273 of 2009 (Cybercrime). 2. SERVICE DESCRIPTION PetHelp is an academic mobile platform developed at Universidad del Quindio that connects people interested in pet adoption, reporting, and care. The service includes: - Posting pets for adoption, lost, or found. - Offering temporary foster homes. - Sharing information about free veterinary events. - Community moderation and reputation system. 3. ACCOUNT REGISTRATION - You must be of legal age (18+) or have authorization from a legal guardian. - Information provided must be truthful, complete, and up to date. - You are responsible for keeping your password confidential. - One account per person; shared accounts are not allowed. 4. PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION (Law 1581 of 2012) As data controller, PetHelp informs: 4.1 Data collected: - Full name and email (during registration). - Approximate geographic location (when using map features). - Published content (text, pet images). 4.2 Purpose of processing: - Manage your account and authentication. - Facilitate adoption and pet reporting. - Send relevant notifications (new posts, comments). - Generate anonymous usage statistics. 4.3 Data subject rights (Art. 8, Law 1581/2012): You have the right to: - Know, update, and rectify your personal data. - Request proof of your granted authorization. - Be informed about how your data is used. - Revoke authorization and request data deletion. - Access your data free of charge. - File complaints before the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC). To exercise these rights, contact: pethelp.soporte@udq.edu.co 4.4 Security: Data is stored in Firebase (Google Cloud) with encryption in transit and at rest, following international ISO 27001 security standards. 5. ACCEPTABLE USE Users agree to: - Not publish false, offensive, violent, or animal abuse promoting content. - Not use the platform for commercial or profit purposes. - Respect Law 84 of 1989 and Law 1774 of 2016 (animals are sentient beings). - Not impersonate other users. - Not attempt to compromise application security. 6. USER CONTENT - You retain rights over the images and text you publish. - You grant PetHelp a non-exclusive license to display content within the platform. - The moderation team may remove content that violates these terms. 7. MODERATION Posts are reviewed by designated moderators. PetHelp reserves the right to approve, reject, or remove content without prior notice when non-compliance is detected. 8. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY - PetHelp is an academic project and does not guarantee the accuracy of third-party posts. - We are not responsible for adoption agreements between users. - We recommend verifying identity and conditions before any transfer or adoption. 9. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY Source code, design, and PetHelp brand belong to the development team of Universidad del Quindio. Reproduction without authorization is prohibited. 10. MODIFICATIONS We reserve the right to modify these terms. Changes will be notified through the app. 11. APPLICABLE LAW AND JURISDICTION These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Colombia. Any dispute will be resolved before the competent courts of Armenia, Quindio. 12. CONTACT Universidad del Quindio - Systems Engineering Program Email: pethelp.soporte@udq.edu.co By clicking "Accept", you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms and Conditions and the Personal Data Processing Policy.

At PetHelp, we take your privacy seriously. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our adoption platform.
We may collect information such as your name, email address, approximate location, and pet preferences to improve your search and adoption experience.
We use your data to connect you with shelters and users, personalize pet recommendations, and keep the community safe.
We do not sell your personal data. We only share required information with verified shelters when you start an adoption process.
You can access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time from your account settings.
Anyone on PetHelp can see your profile, pets for adoption, and badges.
Only users who follow you can see your full activity.
No one can see your profile except you. You will not be able to publish pets for adoption.

Your ideal companion is just a few clicks away. This guide will help you navigate the app and make the most of our features to connect pets with loving homes.
Create your account in seconds. You only need an email or your Google account. Complete your profile with a friendly photo to build trust in the community.
Explore thousands of pets using our smart filters. When you find your ideal companion, send an adoption request directly from their profile.
Upload clear photos with good lighting. Describe the pet\'s personality, likes, and medical needs. A good story increases adoption chances.
Always meet in safe, public places. Verify the shelter or adopter\'s information and never send money in advance without guarantees.
How do I adopt a pet?
To adopt, go to the profile of the pet you are interested in and click \'Request Adoption\'. The owner or shelter will review your request and contact you.
Yes, PetHelp is completely free for both adopters and those putting pets up for adoption. We are a non-profit community.
How do I verify my shelter?
To get the \'Verified Shelter\' badge, you must send your legal documentation to verification@pethelp.app. The process takes 3 to 5 business days.
What if I can\'t take care of my adopted pet?
If an unforeseen event occurs, we ask that you first contact the shelter or person who gave you the pet. They have priority in receiving it back.
How do I report a suspicious user?
Go to the user\'s profile, tap the three dots in the upper right corner and select \'Report\'. Our moderation team will review the case.
Our support team is available 24/7 to help you with any issues.
